session_prices: from the USDT-M 15m archive: open of the 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC bars of each day; session log return = ln(next boundary open / this boundary open); a session with a missing boundary is missing

trials.SE1_ASIA_MOM_U50: sum of Asia-session log returns over the 28 days cut-27..cut (>= 24 valid); long the HIGHEST
trials.SE2_US_MOM_U50: sum of US-session (16-24 UTC) log returns over the same days (>= 24 valid); long the HIGHEST
trials.SE3_ASIA_MINUS_US_U50: SE1 signal minus SE2 signal; long the HIGHEST
trials.JR1_JUMPS_U50: count of days in cut-89..cut with |close-to-close return| > 3 x median |return| of the same 90 days (>= 60 valid); long the LOWEST
trials.FV1_FUNDING_VOL_U50: standard deviation of the individual funding rates with funding time in days cut-27..cut (>= 40 rates); long the LOWEST
